title: check_esm_setup
description: Read-only ESM settings health check (about 1 minute). scope: all (default), prereq (fresh-install prerequisites), quoting, assets (add assets to quote), performance, console, permissions, adminjobs. Returns each item as OK / Warning / Needs Fix with the reason, current vs recommended value (secrets masked), a help link and a Fix it message, plus a Health check report card. Nothing changes. Offer fixes one by one; each fix is a preview the person approves (apply_esm_change, manage_esm_permissions or run_esm_admin_jobs).

scope.description: all (default), prereq, quoting, assets, performance, console, permissions or adminjobs.

message.description: Plain-language result to tell the person.

previewToken.description: Returned by a preview; pass it back with mode=commit and the same inputs only after the person approved.

fix.description: How to resolve a problem when success is false.
